sentences.text: 3. Learned advocate representing the State respondents has filed a communication dated 12th March, 2026 of Officer-in-Charge, Mohanpur Police Station, Barrackpore Police Commissionerate and same is taken on record.

entities.text: Mohanpur Police Station, Barrackpore Police Commissionerate
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted on behalf of the State respondents that based on the complaint lodged by the petitioner an FIR was registered.

5. However, on perusal of the communication dated 12 th March, 2026, it appears that a criminal prosecution was initiated based on the complaint of husband of the respondent no.4 being Mohanpur Police Station Case No.100 of 2024 dated 23 rd June, 2025 under Sections 420/406/506 of IPC.
6. Therefore, it appears steps taken based on the complaint lodged by the petitioner are not disclosed in the communication dated 12th March, 2026 of Officer- in-Charge, Mohanpur Police Station.
7. Respondent no.4 is represented by learned advocates.

8. Learned advocate representing the State respondents has prayed for accommodation to file a report disclosing the steps taken based on the complaint lodged by the petitioner on 4th December,
2025.

9. Let such report be filed by the Officer-in-Charge, Mohanpur Police Station being respondent no.3 by fortnight from date.
10. List the matter under the same heading for further consideration on 27th April, 2026.
(SAUGATA BHATTACHARYYA, J.)
